description:
Read credited conversion journeys for an authorized workspace. Earned is counted by PlainRouter from its own journeys; claimed is reported by Meta. The two are shown side by side and are never reconciled. The output carries no PlainRouter person or visitor identifiers. UTM labels and ad ids appear exactly as the merchant's links sent them.
basis_note explains how the two counts differ.

conversion_kinds.description: Conversion kinds to count; defaults to subscribed and one-off purchase conversions.

cursor.description: Continue the journey page using next_cursor from the previous response.

from.description: Inclusive beginning of the journey window. Defaults to 30 days before the end time.

level.description: Channel dimension used for per-channel rows. The broadest level, platform, is the default.

lookback.description: Maximum time between a touch and conversion, in days.

to.description: Inclusive end of the journey window. Defaults to the current time.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID returned by list_workspaces. Required when this credential reaches multiple workspaces.

name: get_conversion_journeys
title: Get conversion journeys
